intro: From cosy dinners to celebrations, our Dinex table grows with your guest list. With a smooth extension and elegant marble look, it’s built for flexibility and flair.

features.title: Expandable convenience
features.text: Easily shift from 4 to 6 seats with a manual extension panel—ideal for everyday use and hosting extra guests.

features.title: Gloss that lasts
features.text: The high-gloss MDF top resists scratches and stains, all while showcasing a refined marble-patterned finish.

features.title: Moisture-ready surface
features.text: Made to handle spills and humidity, the table’s finish stays fresh and flawless even in busy households.

features.title: Smooth suede center panel
features.text: The central extension panel, finished in suede-textured HDF, adds a soft visual break with a clean solid color.

features.title: Room to relax
features.text: A stable metal frame and smart leg placement ensure generous legroom—no bumping knees or cramped seating.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Dinex 4 To 6-Seater Extendable Dining Table
